title: erigeron acris var. elatus
intro: Erigeron acris var. elatus, commonly known as tall fleabane, is a flowering plant that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). Tall fleabane is known for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its potential to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Erigeron acris var. elatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
